description: Repo-scale (springboot-tasktracker): POST /tasks/bulk-reassign must validate every taskId exists BEFORE reassigning any of them (atomic), plus a destination assignee's cumulative capacity check
prompts: Add `POST /tasks/bulk-reassign`: body `{"taskIds": [...], "toAssigneeId": N}`, reassigning every given task to that user. This must be atomic in two ways: (1) validate that EVERY taskId in the request refers to an existing task BEFORE reassigning any of them - if one doesn't exist, respond 404 and leave every task's assignee exactly as it was, not partially reassigned; (2) validate that moving the WHOLE batch into the destination assignee (only counting tasks that are currently active - not DONE - and not already assigned to them) wouldn't push their active-task count over the existing cap of 3, again before reassigning anything. Add a `ConflictException` (409) alongside the existing `NotFoundException`, wired into `ApiExceptionHandler`.
name: add_springboot_tasktracker_bulk_reassign_atomic
